title: Finite representable coequalizer presentations of constructible etale sheaves
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: A finite stratification alone does not furnish a global presentation by etale representables. The proof must extend stalk elements from the closed stratum to ambient etale neighbourhoods, use quasi-compactness to make finitely many lifts suffice, and inductively combine this with the open strata; the kernel relation then supplies the coequalizer.
